newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil stable in thin market.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil stable in thin market.

text.p: NWE straight run fuel oil prices remained broadly stable on Monday with little business conducted and most interest in Russian material, traders said.

NWE low sulphur values stood at a notional $105/$108 fob with little business seen done. A cargo of Tunisian low sulphur was heard sold in the Med on Friday to a large Italian utility for an undisclosed price.
Dealers said Russian material continued to appear at Baltic ports at attractive prices. A cargo of M-40 was being discussed on Friday at around two means +$6, one said.
